_comment: Golden Chef Journey story text. Edit freely; src/core/story.ts validates it (tests fail if a page, visit or recipe is missing). {name} = the chef's name, {dish} = the dish being ordered. Never use he/she for the chef.

body: Our apple stall is yours now! I'm off to see the world.
Instead of a cookbook, I left you my notebook of riddles. Each new page brings a new dish.
Be kind to every customer and pick your apples well. See you soon!

pages.title: Aomori Bay
pages.riddle: Squeeze me and I'm a drink. Cut me just right and I grow two long ears. What am I?

doodle.caption: Me, trying rabbit ears. They look like cats!

pages.where: Our stall is by Aomori Bay. Wave to ASPAM, the big triangle building!

pages.title: Sweet and sticky
pages.riddle: Bubble me slowly in a pot and I spread on toast. Dip me in shiny red sugar and I'm a festival treat.

doodle.caption: A jar of jam. (I ate it all.)

postcard.text: Greetings from Norway! The fjords are SO tall. I told a ship captain called Ingrid all about your apples.

pages.title: Off to Lake Towada
pages.riddle: Hirosaki's favourite: apples tucked in golden pastry. And my breakfast: jam on crunchy bread.

postcard.text: Bonjour from Paris! Chef Amélie bakes an upside-down apple tart. I said my grandchild's pie is better!

pages.where: Time to move! Set up the stall beside Lake Towada, where the water is deep and blue.

pages.title: The red gates
pages.riddle: Layer me with cold yogurt. Bake me whole until I'm soft. Simmer me slowly until I shine.

doodle.caption: A flying fox stole my apple!

postcard.text: G'day from Queensland! Carer Mia looks after baby flying foxes. They love juicy fruit, just like you.

pages.where: Pack up! Next stop: Takayama Inari Shrine and its hill of red torii gates.

pages.title: The last page
pages.where: You found every dish, {name}. A Golden Chef! I've told the whole world about our stall, so keep an eye on the post...

regulars.name: Sota
regulars.tagline: Wants to be a chef one day

visits.line: Hi! I'm Sota. I'm going to be a chef too! Can I watch you make {dish}?
I practised your moves at home! Swish, swish! Could I have {dish}, please, Chef {name}?
What's your best tip, Chef {name}? Mine is: always wash the apples! {dish}, please.
I opened a pretend apple stall next door! But today I'm the customer. {dish}, please!

regulars.name: Yui
regulars.tagline: Learning to cook for her little brother

visits.line: Hello! I'm Yui. I'm learning to cook for my little brother. Is {dish} hard to make?
My brother loved the last one! Could I have {dish}? I'll watch how you do it.
I tried the recipe at home. It was... a little burnt. Could I have {dish}, please?
I made jam! It's lumpy, but I brought it for a taste. And {dish}, please!

regulars.name: Grandpa Kiyoshi
regulars.tagline: Loves pie apples... for some reason

visits.line: Good day! I'm Kiyoshi. {dish}, please. Oh, and do you sell apples for pies?
{dish}, please. And six more pie apples... still no reason!
All right, I'll tell you. I'm entering the town pie contest! Wish me luck. {dish}, please.
Second place in the pie contest! This ribbon is half yours, Chef {name}. Let's celebrate with {dish}!
Hi, I'm Mei! I collect apples too. Aomori grows more apples than anywhere else in Japan! {dish}, please.
Apple fact: the Fuji apple was first grown here in Aomori! {dish}, please.
Apple fact: apples float because about a quarter of an apple is air! {dish}, please.
This is my rarest apple, Oirase, named after a stream near Lake Towada. It's yours! And {dish}, please.

news.title: Thank you!
news.text: Watching you cook is out of this world!
news.headline: Sota pinned a note to your stall

news.title: Aomori Daily
news.text: Chef {name}'s apple stall is the talk of the town!
news.headline: Your stall is in the newspaper!

news.title: You're invited!
news.text: Come and cook at the Hirosaki Apple Festival!
news.headline: A letter came in the post

news.title: The Golden Apple award
news.text: The whole town cheers for Chef {name}! And look who's here...
news.headline: A ceremony, just for you

ojiichanVisit.line: Surprise! I came home for your big day, {name}. One {dish} for your proud Ojiichan, please!
ojiichanVisit.tagline: Your grandpa, home from his travels!

intro._comment: The opening (src/ui/Intro.tsx): Ojiichan flies over Aomori and drops his letter onto the empty stall.

firstLetter: When your stall does well, people send you notes, newspapers and invitations. Keep them all in your Scrapbook (in My chef).

stage2Intro._comment: Plays the day after Ojiichan's ending, then opens the first Golden Request.
stage2Intro.ojiichan1: {name}, remember my postcards? I told everyone I met about your apples.
stage2Intro.ojiichan2: You're a Golden Chef now, so the whole world is your stall. Let's open the first one together!
stage2Intro.tip: Golden Requests are menus of several dishes. Pick the apple that fits each clue, then cook them one after another!

requests.title: Friendship Fjord Platter
letter: Hello, Chef {name}! I'm Captain Ingrid, from Norway.
Did you know Norway helped make salmon sushi popular in Japan?
Now I'm cooking a thank-you dinner for my crew. Will you make the dessert menu?

twist.name: Picky guest
twist.text: No very sweet apples. Ingrid likes them tangy!

tasting: Tangy and crisp, like the sea air!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! Take this little longship for your stall.

requests.title: The Golden Tower Party
letter: Konnichiwa, Chef {name}! I'm Mr. Ōgane. My toy company in Tokyo turns 100!
Did you know Tokyo Skytree is the tallest tower in Japan? I want a party tower even taller!
There will be lots of guests, so please cook every dish twice!

dishes.name: Tower-Top Pie
dishes.clueText: Crisp, so it holds its shape

twist.name: Big party
twist.text: Cook each dish twice. The second round is faster!

tasting: Let's try the tower… wobble wobble!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! This golden lucky cat will bring your stall good luck.

requests.title: The Great Apple Challenge
letter: Bonjour, Chef {name}! I'm Chef Amélie from Paris.
My famous tarte Tatin is an apple tart baked upside down!
Your Ojiichan says your pie is better. A friendly cook-off? Only one retry, chef!

dishes.name: Challenge Baked Apple
dishes.clueText: Firm and tart, so it holds its shape

twist.name: Rush order
twist.text: Only one "Try again" for the whole menu!

requests.thanks: Merci, Chef {name}! Take my copper pan. Let's be pen pals!

requests.title: Snacks for Space
letter: Hello from space, Chef {name}! I'm Commander Leila.
Astronauts eat tortillas instead of bread, because crumbs float into the machines!
Could you send up some apple snacks? No crumbs, please!

dishes.name: Compote Pouch
dishes.clueText: Firm, so the wedges stay whole

twist.name: Picky guest
twist.text: Space snacks must look fresh and pale: yellow or green apples only!

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, Mission Control says try another.
tasting: Calling the stall from orbit… slurp!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! Here is a photo of Earth from space, signed by the crew.

requests.title: Farewell Feast for the Flying Foxes
letter: G'day, Chef {name}! I'm Carer Mia from a flying-fox rescue in Queensland.
Flying foxes are big fruit bats. They spread seeds and help plant forests!
My orphan pups are ready to fly free. Will you cook their farewell feast?

dishes.name: Pup Juice
dishes.clueText: Extra juicy (pups squeeze out the juice!)

twist.name: Picky guest
twist.text: No added sugar, so only naturally sweet apples!

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, the pups want something sweeter.
tasting: Here you go, little pups… munch munch!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! This little flying fox will hang upside down on your stall.

requests.title: The Pink Birthday
letter: Greetings, Chef {name}! I am Princess Amara of Rosevale.
Some apples are pink inside, like Kurenai no Yume from Hirosaki!
Everything at my birthday party must be pink. Even the food!

twist.name: Colour theme
twist.text: Every apple must be pink inside!

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, that one isn't pink inside.
tasting: A pink feast! Let me taste…
Delightful! I crown you Royal Apple Chef!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Royal Apple Chef {name}! Please take my pink paper lantern.

requests.title: Save the Royal Dinner!
letter: Good evening, Chef {name}. I am the Head Butler of a royal palace in London.
Our pastry chef is ill on the night of the royal dinner! Chefs from around the world are trying out.
The Bramley apple first grew in England over 200 years ago. Quickly now, only one retry!

twist.name: Rush order
twist.text: The dinner starts soon! Only one "Try again" for the whole menu.

tasting: The guests are asking for seconds!
requests.thanks: With the palace's thanks, Chef {name}. Please accept this tiny silver teapot.

requests.title: Big Apple meets Aomori
letter: Hello, Chef {name}! I'm Grandma Rosa from New York.
New York's nickname is "the Big Apple"!
My grandson studies in Hirosaki now. I want to taste his new home, with the biggest apples you have!

twist.name: Big apples
twist.text: Only the biggest apples: L size!

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, Rosa wants a bigger one.
tasting: Just like my grandson said… mmm!
Oh my, happy tears! You're family now!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! Take this little yellow taxi, from New York with love.

requests.title: Warm Treats for the Penguin Team
letter: Hello from the ice, Chef {name}! I'm Dr. Kiri, a penguin scientist in Antarctica.
Emperor penguins huddle together in big groups to keep warm in the winter storms!
My team counts penguins all day in the snow. Could you send us warm treats? Small ones, so they fit in our backpacks!

dishes.name: Hot Compote Mugs
dishes.clueText: Firm, so the wedges stay whole

dishes.name: Penguin Wedges
dishes.clueText: Red skin, bright on the snow

twist.name: Tiny apples
twist.text: Only tiny apples (S size), so they fit in our backpacks!

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, that one won't fit in a backpack.
tasting: Warm and cosy, even in the snow!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! This little toy penguin is from our research station.

requests.title: Chuseok Family Feast
letter: Annyeong, Chef {name}! I'm Ji-woo. My grandchildren call me Halmeoni: that means Grandma in Korean.
Chuseok is Korea's harvest festival. Families visit each other and share apples, pears and rice cakes!
All my grandchildren are coming home this year. There are so many of them, please cook every dish twice!

twist.name: Big party
twist.text: Cook each dish twice. The second round is faster!

tasting: Round and sweet, like the harvest moon!
requests.thanks: Thank you, Chef {name}! In Korea, children look for a rabbit in the full moon. Here is a little moon rabbit for you.

requests.title: Thank-you Treats for the Keepers
letter: Jambo, Chef {name}! I'm Ranger Amani, from an elephant orphanage in Kenya.
Elephants use their trunks to drink, smell, hug and even say hello!
Our keepers sleep next to the baby elephants every night. Will you cook them a thank-you treat? They love a good crunch!

twist.name: Picky guest
twist.text: Crunchy apples only! The keepers love a good crunch.

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, that one isn't crunchy enough.
tasting: Even the baby elephants want a sniff!
requests.thanks: Asante, Chef {name}! That means thank you in Swahili. This carved wooden elephant is for your stall.

requests.title: Carnival Snacks for the Samba School
letter: Olá, Chef {name}! I'm Lucas, a drummer in a samba school in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
At Carnival, thousands of dancers and drummers parade through the city!
We practise all night and we're hungry. The parade starts soon, so quick, chef: only one retry!

twist.name: Rush order
twist.text: The parade starts soon! Only one "Try again" for the whole menu.

requests.matchMiss: Hmm, that one's out of rhythm.
tasting: Delicious! Now we can drum all night!
requests.thanks: Obrigado, Chef {name}! Take this tiny samba drum and keep the beat!

recipeIntros._comment: After Golden Chef, a regular comes back with each new recipe they found (A Sota, B Yui, C Kiyoshi, D Mei).

apple_kinton.line: Chef {name}! At New Year my grandma made Golden Apple Kinton: sweet potato and apple! Will you try it?

apple_jelly.line: My brother wants something cold and wobbly. I found Fresh Apple Jelly in a cookbook! Can you make it?

whole_apple_pie.line: At the pie contest I heard about a pie with a whole apple inside! Whole Apple Pie, please, Chef {name}!

apple_daifuku.line: I saw Azuki Apple Daifuku at the sweet shop. Mochi with apple inside! Let's try it!

apple_dorayaki.line: I found Apple Nama Dorayaki at a café: fluffy pancakes with apple and cream inside! Please make it!

apple_keema.line: My grandson says apples make curry sweeter. Will you make Apple Keema Curry?

apple_shumai.line: I want to cook dinner for my brother. Can apples go in shumai? Let's find out!

apple_cheesecake.line: My mum bakes cake in the rice cooker! Could you make Apple Cheesecake?

apple_pork.line: Pork and apple go together like me and pie. Apple Pork Rolls, please!

red_flesh_tart.line: Look, a pink-inside apple from my collection! It would make a perfect Pink Apple Tart.

festival_pie.line: The Apple Festival is coming! Everyone says you should bake a Festival Pie!

goldenRank.title: Golden Chef rank {n}!
goldenRank.line: Keep cooking, Chef {name}! The world is watching.
